snippet.title: GTA 6 Is Destroying Nick Eh 30’s Entire Brand
snippet.description:
Nick Eh 30 spent years building the most family friendly brand in gaming. Then GTA 6 came out. He kicked a dog, held up a train full of passengers, and ran people over laughing the whole time, and the internet hasn't stopped talking about it.

In this video I break down what he actually did, why GTA 6's realism makes it hit so different from GTA 5, whether he's just clip farming, and whether that family friendly brand was a mask all along. Let me know what you think in the comments.

0:00 Nick Eh 30 asked for a no gore mode
1:06 1. He said no gore
3:45 2. It's the realism
6:37 3. Clip farming?
8:35 4. Was it a mask?

My video on GTA 6's realism: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tuQAuVsxMfQ
